pages.text: $(thing)Requirement$(): Path of Darkness 3, costs 3 levels.$(br)$(thing)Type$(): passive (wheel $(thing)T$()).$(br2)When activated, a block of the Beyond is left behind where you stand. Play as usual. When deactivated, you are teleported to the Echo, and the block disappears.
The block does not break, and you can walk through it. If there is no space for the block, the ability cannot be activated.
